noticias.titular: Harper rebounds from gaffe, Bohm saves Phillies with HR in 10th
noticias.texto: Alec Bohm put Philadelphia ahead with a two-out home run in the 10th inning, and the Phillies beat the Braves to force a decisive Game 3 in their National League Wild Card Series.

noticias.titular: Mattingly's call to Duran in 7th backfires in Phillies' loss
noticias.texto: Don Mattingly wanted the Phillies' best reliever on the mound as early as possible in the opener of a best-of-three NL Wild Card Series against the Braves, but the move backfired when All-Star closer Jhoan Duran allowed a three-run homer in a Game 1 loss.
